title: How To Break Free From Habitual Sin | Stop Going Back To The Same Sin
description:
How to break free from habitual sin and stop going back to the same sin.

Most of us fight sin at the last step. The Bible says it starts with a thought. How to take the thought captive, renew your mind, and build a simple daily Bible habit. This message draws on a teaching by Johnny Chang on the Bryce Crawford Podcast.

"Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;" 2 Corinthians 10:5 (KJV)

Scriptures in this video (KJV): Romans 7:15, James 1:14-15, Proverbs 23:7, Jeremiah 17:9, Isaiah 55:8-9, 2 Corinthians 5:17, Romans 8:1, 1 John 1:9, 2 Corinthians 10:5, Psalm 119:11, Romans 12:2, Romans 10:17, Lamentations 3:22-23.

Type amen in the comments, and send this to a friend who needs it. Subscribe to Blessed Prayers for more.
